standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 414-417: the description in terms of which the component formulas are stated.

standard_prerequisites.name: The morphism of topoi f_Zar attached to a morphism of simplicial spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 423-433: in its proof, for V subset Y_n open the category (I_V^u)^opp has as a cofinal subcategory the opens U subset X_n with f_n^{-1}(U) superset V, ordered by inclusion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sheafification of the pullback presheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 433-445: f_n^{-1}F_n is the sheafification of the presheaf f_{n,p}F_n.

core_obligations: Part (1) (proof line 423): (f_{Zar,*}G)_n = f_{n,*}G_n, immediate from the definitions.

Part (2) (lines 423-445): by the cofinality recorded in the functoriality proof, the restriction of u_p F to opens of Y_n is the presheaf f_{n,p}F_n; since f_Zar^{-1}F = u_s F is the sheafification of u_p F, sheafification uses only coverings, and coverings in Y_Zar use only inclusions between opens on the same Y_n, the result follows from the componentwise sheafification f_n^{-1}F_n of f_{n,p}F_n.
proof_roadmap: Read off the pushforward formula from the definitions.
Identify the presheaf pullback componentwise via the cofinal subcategory of opens.
Conclude by sheafifying componentwise, using the form of coverings in Y_Zar.
difficulty_reason: Description lemma (statement 413-426, proof 428-445): computes the pushforward and pullback of the topos morphism f_Zar componentwise - the pushforward is immediate, the pullback via the cofinality of the indexing categories and the fact that sheafification and the coverings of Y_Zar are componentwise; no verification is omitted. H2: componentwise bookkeeping over the topos morphism.
